description: This file defines a service object 'qosApi' with methods to interact with Quality of Service (QoS) configurations, including getting and updating bandwidth and rules through imported API functions.

methods.name: getBandwidth
methods.description: Fetches the current QoS bandwidth configuration.

methods.name: updateBandwidth
methods.description: Updates the QoS bandwidth configuration with the provided settings.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Retrieves the current QoS rule details.

methods.name: updateRule
methods.description: Applies new QoS rules based on provided request data.
